$DOGE +17%
$SHIB +25%

$KISHU +84%

$DOGE moved up in 5 waves from March 2020 to May 2021, which led to a 600x increase. After that it has just been moving in a downwards channel and actually held up way better than I thought it would. Still, much more downside possible. https://t.co/8g9dkaFFXt

$DOGE is currently up 32% from yesterday's lows, after it became apparent that Elon Musk will buy Twitter. Will be interesting to see if crypto assets will play a more significant role in the future for Twitter users.
$DOGE: I still think 1.5 USD is possible, potentially at the end of this year, but I would also view that as a major top for years to come. https://t.co/DIVMHEbrVs
